description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions for handling RLC AM Protocol Data Units (PDUs), including headers and status PDUs, with support for serialization and deserialization, as well as formatting for debugging.

classes.name: rlc_am_status_pdu
classes.description: Represents an RLC AM Status Protocol Data Unit (PDU), managing NACKs, packing/unpacking, and control information.

methods.name: refresh_packed_size
methods.description: Updates the cached packed size based on current NACKs.

methods.name: nack_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a given NACK when packed.

methods.name: pack_12bit
methods.description: Serializes the status PDU with 12-bit SN fields into a buffer.

methods.name: pack_18bit
methods.description: Serializes the status PDU with 18-bit SN fields into a buffer.

methods.name: unpack_12bit
methods.description: Deserializes a 12-bit SN status PDU from a buffer.

methods.name: unpack_18bit
methods.description: Deserializes an 18-bit SN status PDU from a buffer.
